LanguageData.MooGirl_KnightlyOrnament.label: Mugirl Knightly Ornament
LanguageData.MooGirl_KnightlyOrnament.description: A knightly neck ornament woven from supple leather and polished metal plates, shaped to follow the curve of the throat with both stability and grace. A finely worked heraldic emblem rests at its centre and sways subtly with each motion, its muted sheen declaring honour without ostentation. Soft stitching along the edges keeps it comfortable even while running or fighting. It is both adornment and symbol, a quiet pledge to oath and glory.
LanguageData.MooGirl_PlateArmor.label: Mugirl Plate Armour
LanguageData.MooGirl_PlateArmor.description: A heavy medieval cuirass of riveted refined steel plates, built to meet bolts and blades head-on. Its mirror-bright finish belies tremendous weight, and only a strong Mugirl can endure wearing it for long on the battlefield. Mobility is sacrificed, but the protection it offers is so absolute that the wearer becomes a walking bulwark of steel.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_Carrying_Equipment.label: Mugirl Specialised Field Gear
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_Carrying_Equipment.descriptio: Field gear widely issued to Mugirl revolutionaries during the Myrick Revolutionary War. Its load-bearing satchels and tactical fittings provide battlefield supplies that help reduce ranged weapon cooldown time.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack.label: Mugirl Mechanic Backpack Lv1
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack.description: A mechanic backpack that grants a small increase to a Mugirl's bandwidth.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack_B.label: Mugirl Mechanic Backpack Lv2
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack_B.descriptio: A mechanic backpack that grants a moderate increase to a Mugirl's bandwidth.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack_C.label: Mugirl Mechanic Backpack Lv3
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack_C.descriptio: A mechanic backpack that grants a large increase to a Mugirl's bandwidth.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack_D.label: Mugirl Mechanic Backpack Lv4
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicBackpack_D.descriptio: A mechanic backpack that grants an immense increase to a Mugirl's bandwidth.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_PowerArmor.label: Mugirl Recon Armour
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_PowerArmor.description: Lightweight recon armour that protects the torso's vital areas. A perfect balance of defence and provocation, where distracting the enemy becomes part of the tactic.
LanguageData.MooGirl_ReconArmor.label: Mugirl Recon Armour "Rapidité Écarlate"
LanguageData.MooGirl_ReconArmor.description: Vache Rousse presents lightweight reconnaissance armour, providing protection for the torso's key areas.\nIt achieves a perfect balance between defence and provocation; distracting the enemy is itself a strategy.
